correctness.rationale: The Huber score and its zero interval give a finite-piecewise-affine center. Unique-root chambers have derivatives w_j/W_I with exact strict signed-balance feasibility; flat-zero-interval chambers have two half derivatives and are dominated by a feasible two-inlier state. The induced star l1 column norm is 1+(m-2) max_j q_j. Integration gives the global inequality and explicit rational finite pairs attain every candidate. Independently replayed checker verifies rational witnesses, parity and sampled pairs for m=2..12; all-dimensional claim depends on the analytic proof.
